anomalies.message: CPU load average is consistently above the number of cores, indicating potential over-utilization.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating potential inactivity or malfunction.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Evaluate and potentially reconfigure AI strategies to ensure they are actively learning and generating opportunities.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough analysis of CPU usage to identify and address processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, which is critical for real-time trading platforms.

recommendations.action: Review AI system configuration and logs to diagnose why no learning cycles or opportunities are being generated.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform competitiveness.

recommendations.action: Assess the effectiveness of active trading strategies and consider adjustments or enhancements.
recommendations.rationale: No active trades and zero ROI suggest that current strategies may not be effective.
